messages:
Maya Patel: FYI PR #482 touches function-calling examples. I ran the examples in the new SDK (v1.0) and a few JSON-schema snippets break parsing in our sample app.
Tom Reed: which snippets?
Maya Patel: the 'structured_response' example in docs/guide/tool-calls.md currently expects `result.data` but v1 uses `tool_call.output`.
Jordan Li: oh that explains the lint failures I saw in the examples suite. The sdk-snippets CI job didn't flag it because the fixture uses v0.9.
Maya Patel: @Jordan agreed — we need compatibility notes + a migration example. Also some links in that file point to the old repo layout.
Eva Solis: can we add both migration and a backwards-compatible snippet? e.g. show old envelope -> new envelope mapping with a tiny code sample.
Maya Patel: exactly. Suggested snippet:
```js
// migrate old response
const out = response.tool_call?.output ?? response.result?.data;
```
Tom Reed: that's concise. Also add a runtime guard for parse failures and fallback to parse by schema with try/catch.
Jordan Li: I'll open a small PR that updates the snippet + patch CI fixture to run against latest SDK. ETA today.
docs-bot: PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482>
Maya Patel: thanks — assign @Jordan and tag docs-review. Can someone update the 'tool-calling migration' page and add a note about schema 'required' semantics changing for nested objects?
Eva Solis: I'll add the required-field caveat. Also check schema examples: we should add an explicit example of optional fields serialized as null vs omitted.
Tom Reed: and please add a short 'quick checklist' for engineers updating internal snippets: 1) update envelope paths 2) re-run examples CI 3) add migration note link 4) test with streaming responses.
Maya Patel: LGTM. Jordan, once your PR is up, I'll do a quick docs review and merge if CI green.
Jordan Li: PR is up and CI shows one failing snippet test still — investigating.
Maya Patel: drop the failing test link when you have it. If it's just the example fixture I'll force-update it after you fix.
Jordan Li: posted failing log here: 
```
AssertionError: expected response.result to be defined
at examples/test-toolcall.js:42
```
Jordan Li: fix is trivial, pushing now.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #482 — ready for review :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: merging in 10m unless objections.
Eva Solis: no objections.
Tom Reed: no objections. Thanks team :rocket:
Maya Patel: merging. Will follow up to add link fixes for the repo layout changes.
